rules.text: Do not use SikaFuko® Eco-1 for sealing expansion / movement joints.
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: SikaFuko® Eco-1 injection hose can also be used in combination with different waterstop profiles: Internally placed expansion joint waterstops, internally placed expansion joint waterstops with lateral steel plates and externally placed expansion joint and construction joint waterstops
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
